My FiberBox X1 router has a blinking red light.

A blinking red light on the FiberBox X1 indicates optical signal loss (LOS). First, check that the green fiber cable is securely clicked into the PON port, then power-cycle the router for 30 seconds. If it stays red after 5 minutes, I can schedule a technician visit.

Why is my Wi-Fi slow on my laptop?
Connect to your 5GHz network (ending in _5G) for higher throughput, ensure the router is clear of thick walls or appliances, and test over Ethernet to isolate wireless interference.
